description: Defines the QuicSimpleServer class, a toy server implementation for handling QUIC traffic, including server setup, socket management, and request handling.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServer
classes.description: A simple QUIC server class that manages socket listening, request handling, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with configuration, backend, and proof source.

methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to listen on the specified address.
